|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per opponent's turn, if their warrior present where a [Cloud City] Rebel (except Luke) is about to be lost, opponent must choose: capture and seize that Rebel or lose 2 Force. |rulings=* When capturing a character that is being forfeited, that character is captured after applying forfeit value but before being placed in the Lost Pile.<ref name="scomp">card data [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* This Effect does not restore the captured character to normal, so if they are 'hit' then they will be immediately lost upon being seized (due to being 'hit' while no longer participating in the battle).
* This Effect does not say to seize 'if possible' so Dark might be required to release another captive and/or disembark a vehicle in order to seize. See Captives - Seizure ('if possible').
